text.tspan: Codex shows up. Now there are two of them, reviewing each other's code while I watch. By
month-end the roster peaks at five bots: AntiBot · 睿智 · AWS-bot · 小试AI · LanceDB
Test.

ui-rounded,'SF Pro Rounded','Nunito','Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
text.tspan: An "E-twin" — a digital me on Telegram. Eerie but useful. Then the Hermes consolidation: 睿
智 and 小试AI merge into Anti. Five bots become three, same throughput, half the moving
parts. (小试AI stays on as a pen name. It'll outlive us all anyway.)

text.tspan: The EC2 goes. Keeping a server alive just to run cron stopped making sense. Three become
two.

text.tspan: The OpenClaw chapter closes on the 14th; my OpenClaw repos are archived as a record. A
week later Claude Code and Codex leave my Telegram bridges for the official Remote
Control. Same month, the playground opens: things built purely for fun.

text.font-family: ui-rounded,'SF Pro Rounded','Nunito','Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
ui-rounded,'SF Pro Rounded','Nunito','Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
text.tspan: Grok pulls up a chair at the review table. Codex nearly left mid-month, then stayed. My
prompt folder grows up into a real system with a front desk and a bouncer (see the
Arsenal).

text.tspan: A month of Codex batch images eats the VPN's monthly traffic, so pictures move to
ChatGPT on the web — which is now its only job; judgement calls go to AGY. Grok's
subscription runs out in December, so it's quietly packing up its chair.
